rule_text.name: 702.266a
rule_text.rule: A death knell ability is a special kind of triggered ability that does not have a built-in trigger condition. Instead, it may be triggered by spells, abilities, or game rules (see 702.266b)

rule_text.name: 702.266b
rule_text.rule: As a creature dies, its controller may choose a death knell ability of that creature or another permanent they control. Choosing an ability this way causes it to trigger.
